analyses.name: Bank of America Corporation
analyses.verdict: Cleanest large-bank breakout on the board — VCP + pocket pivot, TV BUY, and no earnings for ~12 weeks.

financials.summary: A rate-driven year: net interest income stabilized as deposit costs peaked, while investment banking and trading rebounded. Solid capital return via buybacks and a rising dividend. The live TradingView widget below shows current figures.
highlights: Total revenue (net of interest expense) roughly $100B
Net income in the ~$27B range
Trading and IB revenue reaccelerating off 2023 lows
CET1 capital comfortably above regulatory minimums; buybacks resumed

accomplishments: Deposit costs peaked and net interest income inflected back to growth
Sizable share-repurchase authorization funded by strong capital ratios
Consumer credit quality held up better than feared through the cycle

journey_52w.summary: From rate-fear laggard to rotation leader. The stock spent early in the window under pressure on deposit-beta and CRE worries, then broke higher as the Fed path clarified and capital-markets revenue reaccelerated. Now sitting on a VCP breakout with a pocket pivot.

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: VCP breakout, RS pushing to new highs

risks: Long-end rate volatility from the Iran conflict
A hard-landing scenario would pressure loan growth
critical.valuation: ~11.7x forward earnings — reasonable for a money-center bank with improving returns; earnings ~83 days out removes near-term event risk.

analyses.name: DaVita Inc.
analyses.verdict: Highest composite score on the board (95) — defensive dialysis franchise that is also trending, with +52% 3-month momentum.

financials.summary: Steady, cash-generative dialysis operator. Revenue growth from rate increases and patient census, with margins aided by cost discipline and aggressive share repurchase shrinking the float. Live numbers in the TradingView widget.
highlights: Revenue in the ~$12.8B range
Double-digit EPS growth aided by heavy buybacks
Strong, predictable operating cash flow
Forward P/E ~13.5x

accomplishments: Continued to shrink share count materially through buybacks
Stabilized treatment volumes post-pandemic
Integrated international expansion

journey_52w.summary: A quiet compounder that turned into a momentum name. Steady operational execution plus a shrinking float drove a persistent uptrend, culminating in a clean VCP breakout and a top composite score.

milestones.label: 2026 YTD
milestones.note: Momentum built to +52% over three months

risks: GLP-1 drugs' long-term impact on kidney-disease progression is a debated overhang
critical.valuation: ~13.5x forward — inexpensive for a defensive compounder with double-digit EPS growth.

analyses.name: Howmet Aerospace Inc.
analyses.verdict: Held. Aerospace/defense supplier riding the airframe cycle AND the new defense bill — TV STRONG_BUY, +71% EPS growth.

financials.summary: Firing on all cylinders: commercial-aerospace build-rate recovery plus defense demand drove strong revenue and outsized margin expansion. Engine-products and fastening segments led. Live figures in the widget.
highlights: Revenue in the ~$7.4B range, up high-teens %
EPS growth ~71% YoY
Record segment operating margins
Raised guidance repeatedly through the year

accomplishments: Record margins on engine-spares demand
Multiple guidance raises
Dividend increases and buybacks initiated on strong free cash flow

journey_52w.summary: One of the cleanest secular uptrends in industrials. Build-rate recovery and aftermarket spares demand produced a steady staircase higher, punctuated by guidance raises; the past year has been a series of orderly bases and breakouts.

milestones.note: Repeated guidance raises on aftermarket strength

critical.valuation: Premium ~46x forward — justified only if margin/EPS momentum persists; the setup is clean but leaves little room for a miss.

analyses.name: General Dynamics Corporation
analyses.verdict: Pure defense prime with direct exposure to the $1T defense bill and an active Middle East conflict — VCP breakout, TV BUY.

financials.summary: Diversified defense/aerospace: Gulfstream business jets, combat systems, marine (submarines), and IT/technologies. Record backlog underpins multi-year revenue visibility. Live numbers in the widget.
highlights: Revenue in the ~$47B range
Record total backlog providing multi-year visibility
Steady mid-single-digit-plus revenue growth
Consistent dividend grower

accomplishments: Record backlog across marine and combat systems
Gulfstream G700 deliveries ramping
Submarine-build funding reinforced by defense appropriations

journey_52w.summary: A steady defensive/geopolitical beneficiary. The stock strengthened as global conflict intensified and defense appropriations grew, forming a tight VCP base before this breakout.

milestones.note: Backlog hit records; Gulfstream deliveries ramped
Middle East conflict + $1T defense bill lifted the group

risks: Earnings in ~6 days — near-term event risk
catalysts: Active Middle East conflict lifting defense demand
critical.valuation: ~20x forward — fair for a backlog-rich prime; the earnings print in ~6 days is the key near-term swing factor.

analyses.name: Cheniere Energy, Inc.
analyses.verdict: The cleanest way to play energy security — US LNG export leader, VCP breakout, TV STRONG_BUY, with Hormuz/Red Sea disruption a direct tailwind.

financials.summary: Long-term take-or-pay LNG contracts produce highly visible, fee-like cash flows, supplemented by spot cargo upside when global gas prices spike. Aggressive debt paydown and buybacks. Live figures in the widget.
highlights: Revenue in the ~$15-16B range
Contracted cash flows provide a stable base
Sixth+ liquefaction trains and Corpus Christi Stage 3 ramping
Large buyback + de-leveraging program

accomplishments: Corpus Christi Stage 3 trains coming online
Long-term SPAs signed with European and Asian buyers
Investment-grade balance sheet achieved via de-leveraging

journey_52w.summary: From energy-transition skepticism to energy-security darling. As European buyers locked in US LNG and Middle East shipping routes came under threat, Cheniere's strategic value re-rated; the chart has been a steady uptrend into this breakout.

milestones.label: Jun-Jul 2026
milestones.note: Hormuz/Red Sea disruption boosted US-LNG strategic premium

risks: Global LNG force-majeure/geopolitical headlines cut both ways
A 2027 supply glut is a known longer-term overhang
critical.valuation: ~13.5x forward — undemanding for the contracted-cash-flow profile; the risk is buying an already-extended move.

analyses.name: Kimco Realty Corporation
analyses.verdict: Grocery-anchored open-air-retail REIT breakout — durable income exactly what buyers want as rates ease; TV BUY, RSI 68.

financials.summary: High-occupancy, grocery-anchored shopping-center portfolio generating steady FFO growth from rent escalators and re-leasing spreads. The RPT acquisition added scale. Live figures in the widget.
highlights: FFO per share growing mid-single digits
Occupancy near record highs (~96%+)
Strong re-leasing spreads on new/renewal leases
Well-covered, growing dividend

accomplishments: Occupancy pushed to record levels
Positive re-leasing spreads across the portfolio
Balance-sheet strength maintained through the rate cycle

journey_52w.summary: A rate-sensitive laggard that turned leader. As the market priced in easier policy, high-quality retail REITs re-rated; Kimco's stable, grocery-anchored cash flows and record occupancy drove a clean breakout.

milestones.note: Occupancy and leasing spreads at cycle highs
REIT rotation as rate-cut odds rose

risks: Rate-sensitive — a back-up in long yields pressures REITs
Consumer-spending softness would hit tenant health
critical.valuation: Reasonable relative to FFO for a best-in-class open-air REIT; the trade is a rates-plus-quality rotation play.

analyses.name: NVIDIA Corporation
analyses.verdict: Held. The one mega-cap tech name still screening clean — VCP breakout, +85% revenue, +214% EPS, and no earnings for ~35 days.

financials.summary: Data-center/AI accelerator demand drove one of the largest revenue and earnings inflections in corporate history, with gross margins in the mid-70s%. The current cycle (Blackwell ramp) extends the run. Live numbers in the widget.
highlights: Revenue +85% YoY (data center the driver)
EPS +214% YoY
Gross margin ~75%
Blackwell platform ramping into strong demand

accomplishments: Blackwell architecture ramp
Data-center revenue at record scale
Sustained ~75% gross margins despite scale

journey_52w.summary: After a sharp mid-cycle shakeout, NVDA rebuilt a tight base and broke out again as Blackwell demand proved durable. It has held up while other mega-cap tech names (GOOGL, ORCL, TSLA) rolled over — a sign it remains the group's true leader.

milestones.label: H1 2026
milestones.note: Base repair after a volatility shakeout

risks: China export-ban headlines (the Moonshot AI chip-access story is topical)
Crowded ownership — sharp drawdowns when sentiment shifts
critical.valuation: ~16.5x forward on the scan's estimate looks undemanding for the growth — the debate is durability of AI capex, not the multiple.

analyses.name: Dell Technologies Inc.
analyses.verdict: Held. The value-priced AI-infrastructure play — +106% 3-month momentum, TV STRONG_BUY, earnings ~43 days out.

financials.summary: AI-optimized server demand (ISG) is the growth engine, offsetting a stabilizing PC (CSG) business. Backlog for AI servers built through the year. Margins are thin (hardware) but cash flow and buybacks are healthy. Live figures in the widget.
highlights: AI-server backlog and shipments ramping sharply
Infrastructure Solutions Group the growth driver
PC business stabilizing off cyclical lows
Dividend + buyback capital return

accomplishments: Record AI-server backlog
Enterprise-AI partnerships (reference architectures)
Returned to revenue growth as ISG accelerated

journey_52w.summary: A cyclical value name re-rated into an AI-infrastructure story. As AI-server orders surged, momentum built to +106% over three months and TradingView flipped to STRONG_BUY; the trend is powerful but now extended.

milestones.label: H1 2026
milestones.note: ISG revenue acceleration confirmed the thesis

risks: AI-server demand concentrated among a few large buyers
critical.valuation: Cheap versus AI peers on a P/E basis, reflecting the low-margin hardware mix; the trade is momentum + re-rating, so respect the extension.

analyses.name: Liquidia Corporation
analyses.verdict: Held. Screens #1 on momentum (+135% 3-mo) with TV STRONG_BUY on its PAH launch — but a small-cap, single-product pharma to size carefully.

financials.summary: Small-cap specialty pharma transitioning from clinical to commercial. Revenue is inflecting sharply off a low base as its inhaled treprostinil (Yutrepia) for pulmonary arterial/PH-ILD hypertension launches. Still investing heavily; profitability is the next milestone. Live figures in the widget.
highlights: Revenue inflecting off a small base (huge % growth)
Yutrepia PAH/PH-ILD commercial launch underway
Cash runway a key focus given launch spend
Not yet consistently profitable

accomplishments: Regulatory clearance and commercial launch of its lead inhaled therapy
Favorable resolution of key patent litigation overhangs
Rapid early prescription uptake

journey_52w.summary: A binary story that broke the right way. Regulatory and legal overhangs cleared, the launch beat early expectations, and the stock went near-parabolic — a spectacular but high-risk move for a small-cap.

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: TV STRONG_BUY; parabolic, top composite score

critical.valuation: Hard to anchor on earnings — valued on launch trajectory. Treat as a small, high-beta satellite, not a core position.

analyses.name: Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX)
analyses.verdict: NEW LISTING. Own the business, not the chart: dominant launch cadence + Starlink's recurring revenue — but a thin, volatile post-IPO tape.

financials.summary: As a newly public company, audited public financials are limited. The investable story is two-fold: (1) the launch business (Falcon 9 reusability + Starship) that dominates global orbital launch, and (2) Starlink, a fast-scaling satellite-broadband business generating growing recurring subscription revenue. Reported figures will populate the widget as disclosures mature.
highlights: Global leader in orbital launch cadence and reusability
Starlink recurring-revenue subscriber base scaling rapidly
Vertically integrated cost advantage (Falcon reuse)
Financials still stabilizing as a public reporter

accomplishments: Record annual launch cadence and booster reuse
Starlink subscriber and coverage expansion (incl. direct-to-cell)
Starship development progressing toward operational payloads
Completed its public listing

journey_52w.summary: The past year is dominated by the IPO event itself. Shares debuted with heavy enthusiasm, then pulled back roughly 28% as post-listing supply/lockup dynamics and valuation debates set in. RSI 18 reflects a washed-out, still-basing new issue rather than a fundamental deterioration.

milestones.label: IPO
milestones.note: High-profile public debut with strong initial demand

milestones.label: Post-IPO
milestones.note: ~28% pullback off the debut; base still forming

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: RSI 18, thin ratings coverage — expected for a new listing

risks: New listing — thin, volatile, headline-driven trade
Down ~28% off debut with no base yet
No reliable analyst estimates/ratings (TV STRONG_SELL is thin-data noise)
watch: First earnings/disclosure as a public company
critical.valuation: Not anchorable on conventional metrics yet — a long-term, small-sized satellite/launch bet, not a quant setup. Ignore the near-term quant score.
